environment.description: Same application deployed on GKE Autopilot cluster with Pod Security Standards enforced at 'restricted' profile. Container spec sets securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem=true. No emptyDir, hostPath, or persistent volume claims attached to the pod. The container runtime overlay is mounted read-only via containerd's readonly_rootfs snapshotter option. SESSION_DIR=/tmp/sessions has no backing volume - all write syscalls to any path return EROFS. Node-level gVisor (runsc) sandbox intercepts filesystem syscalls at the platform level before they reach the kernel VFS layer. The pod's ephemeral storage limit is set to 0Mi preventing any container-writable layer allocation.
